name: @geospatial/map
description: Portable, application-independent GB geospatial map component (MapLibre + PMTiles). Provides geography, rendering, controls, selection, layers and extension points. Applications supply operational data through adapters and overlays.
notes: MapLibre GL JS is loaded by the host at runtime (window.maplibregl) — see README. No AspectLead/Magna business logic; no imports from src/app, lead, customer, Sales Pro or NetSuite modules.
